name: Edward White

text.ability: Once a round at the colony, Edward may attack on any die and feed a medicine card into the swing: three zombies die and nobody rolls for exposure.
text.bio: Can turn the contents of a medicine cabinet into a very bad day for something else.

notes: src: survivors-sources.md row 13 (C11). Die cost 1+ and the attack die in one (F 1.3.1); any medicine-symbol card works, a requested card included (F 1.3.2, F 1.3.3); the card own ability is not used.
